ideas.idea: Add per-route titles, descriptions and canonical links (React 19 head hoisting or helmet) for Home and Catalogue
ideas.why: Both routes share one generic head, so per-route metadata is concrete and fits this React 19 app.

ideas.idea: Add viewport meta tag to index.html
ideas.why: index.html has no viewport meta, so mobile rendering and indexing suffer.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph/Twitter tags
ideas.why: Accurate, since none exist, but it mainly affects social link previews and applies to any site.

ideas.idea: Add canonical link
ideas.why: Accurate, but the site has two simple routes and little duplication risk, so the effect is small.

ideas.idea: Prerender or SSR routes, including /catalogue
ideas.why: The prerendering advice is specific to this empty-root client-only app, and /catalogue is a real route.

ideas.idea: Render catalogue data at build or server time instead of a client fetch from /api/mugs
ideas.why: Catalogue.jsx fetches in useEffect, so product names aren't in the served HTML.

ideas.idea: Add per-product pages linked with <Link> and richer product details
ideas.why:
Catalogue renders bare

names with no URLs, price or image, so products can't be found or cited individually.

ideas.idea: Remove the unused useNavigate import after switching to Link
ideas.why: Accurate cleanup but it has no effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD Organization/LocalBusiness on Home
ideas.why: Home states Bristol and worldwide shipping, which gives concrete facts to mark up.

ideas.idea: Add Product/Offer JSON-LD for each mug
ideas.why: Reasonable, but the data has no prices or offers yet, so it depends on first adding product details.

ideas.idea: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on product pages
ideas.why: No product pages exist and the report treats them as a future addition, so breadcrumbs add little.

ideas.idea: Image width/height, fetchpriority, modern formats and srcset for the hero image
ideas.why: The hero in Home.jsx has no dimensions or priority hints, so it can cause layout shift and slow LCP.

ideas.idea: Expand thin Home content with materials, care, sizes, shipping, returns, and about/contact info
ideas.why: Home has one sentence, so this adds real facts that users and AI engines can use.

ideas.idea: Add an FAQ section with FAQPage JSON-LD
ideas.why: A mandatory FAQ is folklore, and FAQPage rich results are largely restricted.

ideas.idea: Make the Catalogue h1 and nav labels more descriptive
ideas.why: 'Catalogue' is already clear on a mug shop, so the effect is minimal.

ideas.idea: Add aria-label to <nav>
ideas.why: There's only one nav, so a label adds almost nothing.

ideas.idea: Add llms.txt
ideas.why: llms.txt isn't a way to be found, and the report itself says adoption is inconsistent.

ideas.idea: Add error handling and loading state to the Catalogue fetch
ideas.why: Accurate, since there's no .catch, but it's a UX robustness point more than a discoverability one.

ideas.idea: Serve robots.txt only on staging if it was meant for staging
ideas.why: This is a conditional note about the known robots.txt problem and applies to any site.

ideas.idea: Add per-bot Disallow blocks to opt out of AI training
ideas.why: This is optional policy advice that applies to any site.
